summary: I build a full web based stellar object detection site, which uses both spherex data and light curves to find planets and analyze them.
details: This project is an interactive exoplanet detection dashboard that analyzes light curves and SPHEREx-like spectral data to spot possible transit signals and estimate candidate planet properties. Built with Python, FastAPI, JavaScript, and scientific libraries, it provides a practical way to explore exoplanet detection workflows in a user-friendly interface. The project is designed to be easy to use.
